method: Latest reported fiscal quarter available by the case date. Growth = revenue / same quarter prior year - 1; GAAP operating margin = operating income / revenue; cash-only net debt = current debt + long-term debt - cash and cash equivalents. Excludes all investments and operating lease liabilities.

companies.scope: AI accelerators, networking and computing platforms.
Direct computing / accelerator peer; also client, gaming and embedded businesses. GAAP includes acquisition-related amortization.
Broader AI infrastructure peer: custom accelerators and networking; infrastructure software is 30% of quarterly revenue. Consolidated figures include software.
